{{Top|leg}}
The '''Q5A7 Bacta Refinement Plant''' was a [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] producing factory on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Qretu 5]].<ref name="BW">''[[X-Wing: The Bacta War]]''</ref>

It was destroyed by a [[Battle of Qretu 5|raid]] conducted by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and former members of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] in retaliation to former [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]] [[Ysanne Isard]]'s [[Battle of Halanit|attack]] on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Halanit]].<ref name="BW" />
